$comment: openMINDS <-> NDI V_eta crosswalk. The single machine-readable source of truth behind the inline crosswalk comments in build_v_eta.py. Consumed by the round-trip CI test (tests/test_veta.py::test_openminds_crosswalk_round_trips), which asserts every openMINDS property has an explicit entry whose target resolves to a real V_eta field / relation term / global_identifier scheme -- so nothing is SILENTLY dropped. `target_kind`: field (scalar/term field on the entity) | relation (directed_relation term; `endpoint` = parent entity) | global_identifier (rides on entity.global_identifier{scheme}) | implied (recoverable from class/relations, not stored per-instance) | projection (a dataset-level summary recomputed from per-subject statements; deliberately not stored) | deferred (has a designed home not yet built; visible, not silently dropped).

supportChannel.notes: email/discussion form -> field; a support URL is instead documented_by -> web_resource.

author.notes: contributor role = author, carried by the relation term.

isNewVersionOf.notes: version lineage as generic provenance (dataset -derived_from-> dataset).

type.notes: 'DatasetVersion' is implied by the dataset class; not stored per-instance.

studiedSpecimen.notes: the studied subjects; recomputed from the dataset's session -part_of-> dataset membership + subject entities, not restated here.

custodian.notes: steward role; needs a has_custodian relation term (distinct contributor role from has_author).

otherContribution.notes: typed contribution (role on the relation); relation term not yet minted.

copyright.notes: openMINDS Copyright{year, holder}: holder -> relation, year -> a copyright_year field; neither built yet.

homepage.notes: a web_resource reference; reuses documented_by with label='homepage' or a dedicated has_homepage term (TBD).

protocol.notes: protocol reference; documented_by (label='protocol') or a follows_protocol term (TBD).

inputData.notes: input datasets/resources; derived_from or an input_data term (TBD).

isAlternativeVersionOf.notes: sibling-version link; relation term not yet minted.

hasParent.notes: org hierarchy; part_of is entity-typed for subject/session today -- endpoint widening TBD.
